```{r}
# Necessary functions
# SummarySE function
summarySE <- function(data=NULL, measurevar=NULL, groupvars=NULL, na.rm=FALSE,
                      conf.interval=.95, .drop=TRUE) {
  require(plyr)
  
  # New version of length which can handle NA's: if na.rm==T, don't count them
  length2 <- function (x, na.rm=FALSE) {
    if (na.rm==TRUE) sum(!is.na(x))
    else       length(x)
  }
  
  # This does the summary. For each group's data frame, return a vector with
  # N, mean, and sd
  datac <- ddply(data, groupvars, .drop=.drop,
                 .fun = function(xx, col) {
                   c(N    = length2(xx[[col]], na.rm=na.rm),
                     mean = mean   (xx[[col]], na.rm=na.rm),
                     sd   = sd     (xx[[col]], na.rm=na.rm)
                   )
                 },
                 measurevar
  )
  
  # Commenting this rename mean column line, as not assigning measurevar name properly
  # # Rename the "mean" column    
  # datac <- rename(datac, measurevar = mean)
  
  datac$se <- datac$sd / sqrt(datac$N)  # Calculate standard error of the mean
  
  # Confidence interval multiplier for standard error
  # Calculate t-statistic for confidence interval: 
  # e.g., if conf.interval is .95, use .975 (above/below), and use df=N-1
  ciMult <- qt(conf.interval/2 + .5, datac$N-1)
  datac$ci <- datac$se * ciMult
  
  return(datac)
}
```

```{r}
# Read in data
surv_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/amacadam/Dropbox/PhD/Chapter 5- Outplanting/Chapter 5 Data/Outplant_survival.csv", header=T, fileEncoding="UTF-8-BOM")
glimpse(surv_data)
```

```{r}
#change columns to factors
surv_data <- surv_data %>% mutate(Cross2=factor(Cross2),
                                  RegionCross=factor(RegionCross),
                                  Breed=factor(Breed))
```

```{r}
surv_summ<- surv_data %>% 
  filter(Notes != "remove") %>% #filter data of plugs with no juveniles
  select(Cross2, RegionCross, Breed, SurvivalPerc) %>% #select columns of interest
  summarySE(measurevar="SurvivalPerc", groupvars=c("Breed","Cross2","RegionCross"), na.rm=TRUE) #create sumamry data for each Region Cross
```

```{r}
surv_summ<- surv_summ %>% 
  mutate(Newlabel = paste(Cross2, ' (', N, ')', sep=""))
```

```{r}
#plot survival at end
surv_summ %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=RegionCross, y=mean, color=RegionCross, group=Cross2))+
  geom_hline(yintercept=filter(surv_summ, Cross2=="PIxPI")$mean, color='gray', lty='dashed')+
  #geom_hline(yintercept=0, color='gray')+
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=mean-se, ymax=mean+se, color=RegionCross), position=position_dodge(width=0.8))+
  geom_text(aes(label=Newlabel, y=100, color=RegionCross), size=3, angle=90, position=position_dodge(width=0.8), vjust=0.5, hjust=1)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,100), breaks=seq(0,100,20))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c('black', 'gray50', 'goldenrod2', 'firebrick4'), name="", guide=FALSE)+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(20, 18), name="", guide=FALSE)+
  labs(x='Region', y="Survival after 95 days (%)")+
  theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
        legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
        plot.margin = margin(rep(0.5,4)))+
  theme_pubr(base_size = 10)
```
